home.heroTitle: Three generations of hospitality on Lake Garda
home.heroSubtitle: A few steps from the lake, among century-old palms and Brescian flavours, Hotel Conca d'Oro welcomes its guests like family.
home.introText: Hotel Conca d'Oro was born from the Bazzani family's dream: a place where the pace slows down, the lake is always close, and every guest is treated as a long-awaited friend. Today, three generations later, we still take care of every detail with the same passion.
home.highlightsTitle: An experience that feels like home

lake.title: A stone's throw from the lake
lake.text: From our garden you can reach the lakefront and the historic centre of Salò within a short walk.

restaurant.title: Traditional cuisine
restaurant.text: Our restaurant celebrates Brescian cooking with seasonal ingredients and family recipes.

park.title: Park and terrace
park.text: A garden of palms and olive trees with a terrace for breakfasts outdoors and sunset aperitifs.

family.title: Family-run
family.text: Three generations of Bazzanis welcome guests with the same care as always.

home.roomsTeaserTitle: 39 rooms, each with its own soul
home.roomsTeaserText: From the cosy Classic rooms to the bright Lake View ones, every room is designed to feel like home.
home.restaurantTeaserText: Our chef reinterprets traditional classics with lake fish, Riviera olive oil and garden vegetables.

reviews.text: Impeccable hospitality, a family that makes you feel at home. Breakfast on the terrace is unforgettable.
reviews.author: Laura G.

reviews.text: Beautiful location, a few steps from the lake. The restaurant is a gem: authentic Brescian cuisine.
reviews.author: Markus W.

reviews.text: We come back every year. The garden with palms is a slice of paradise.
reviews.author: The Rossi Family

rooms.title: A stay between lake and tradition
rooms.intro: Our 39 rooms are split between the historic building and the wing offering the most open views over Lake Garda. Natural materials, warm fabrics and renovated bathrooms: everything designed for a genuine rest.

types.name: Classic
types.description: Cosy rooms facing the garden or the inner courtyard, furnished with light wood and neutral fabrics.

types.name: Superior
types.description: More spacious, some with a balcony overlooking the garden and the palm terrace.

types.name: Lake View
types.description: Our brightest rooms, with a direct view of Lake Garda and a window onto the mountains.

rooms.policy: Check-in from 2:00 PM, check-out by 11:00 AM. For late arrivals please get in touch — we will always find a tailored solution.

restaurant.title: Brescian cuisine, every day
restaurant.intro: In our restaurant we bring the flavours of the territory to the table: lake fish, traditional spits, Valle Sabbia cheeses and extra-virgin olive oil from the Riviera dei Limoni.
restaurant.conceptText: Family recipes passed down, local suppliers we know by name, seasonality as a rule. Every dish tells a piece of our Garda.
restaurant.menuText: Our menu changes with the seasons. We guide you through the choice with pairings of Brescian and Valtènesi wines.
restaurant.terraceText: In warm months, dining on the terrace among century-old palms and warm lights is a ritual our guests return for every year.

story.title: A story that began in 1952
story.intro: Three generations of hospitality in Salò. Hotel Conca d'Oro is not a company, it's a home the Bazzani family has built by welcoming guests from every corner of the world.

timeline.title: The beginning
timeline.text: The Bazzani grandparents open a small inn with restaurant a few steps from the lake.

timeline.title: The expansion
timeline.text: The second generation turns the inn into a hotel with 39 rooms and personally cares for the palm garden.

timeline.title: The new millennium
timeline.text: We renovate rooms and terrace while keeping the original soul of the historic building.

timeline.title: The third generation
timeline.text: We carry on with the same care as always, adding attention to sustainability and local products.

values.title: True hospitality
values.text: We treat every guest like a family friend, from the first hello to the farewell.

values.title: Territory
values.text: We choose suppliers from Garda and Valle Sabbia. We know their names, their stories.

values.title: Slow time
values.text: Here time flows at the rhythm of the lake: we are not in a hurry, and we invite you to not be either.

gallery.title: Glimpses of the hotel
gallery.intro: The garden, the rooms, the terrace, the restaurant dishes: images that tell the story better than a thousand words.

contact.title: Write to us, call us, drop by
contact.intro: We'll be happy to answer your questions and help you plan your tailor-made stay.

directions.text: A4 motorway exit Desenzano, follow signs for Salò (about 15 minutes).
Desenzano del Garda train station, then bus or taxi to Salò.
Verona Villafranca Airport (60 km), Bergamo Orio al Serio (85 km), Brescia Montichiari (55 km).
